notes: Canonical s&box MCP transports on VENGEANCE. Claude Bridge uses file IPC — it does NOT bind an HTTP port. chomnr owns HTTP :9090/sbox-mcp.

blenderBridge.notes: Editor > Blender Bridge panel. Saved ConVar bridge_autostart (default 1). Blender addon Connect on N-panel s&box tab.

portConflictPolicy.changeChomnrPort: chomnr MCP dock Settings → new port → Install-VengeanceSboxEditorMcp.ps1 -Port N
portConflictPolicy.cornermanLocalVsTunnel: Never run Red reverse tunnel (-R 9090) while Green uses local chomnr on the same port. Use cornerman.modes or Set-CornermanMcpMode.ps1.

RedEditor.description: Green Cursor drives Red editor via tunnel; sbox IPC via SMB to VENGEANCE

LocalEditor.description: Green local s&box editor; fully local MCP — no Red tunnel

DualEditor.description: Red and Green editors both live; Green uses isolated ports
